### God Rejoices to Do You Good
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/god-rejoices-to-do-you-good
Passage: Jeremiah 32:40-41
Points:
- God does not merely commit to doing good for His people; He actively delights in doing so.
- His dedication to blessing believers is unending, marked by genuine joy rather than reluctance.
- When enduring severe trials and feeling hopeless, believers can trust God to do what seems impossible.
- Leaning on God's delight to bless His children guards our faith and rekindles lasting confidence.
